SELECT fish_date_season, fish_date_doy, COUNT(*) as trip_count, 
  SUM(yt) as total_yt, AVG(yt::float / NULLIF(anglers, 0)) as avg_yt_per_angler
FROM trips WHERE fish_date_doy >= 287 AND fish_date_doy <= 297
GROUP BY fish_date_season, fish_date_doy ORDER BY fish_date_season, fish_date_doy

SELECT ts_doy, AVG(wtmp_c * 9.0 / 5.0 + 32) as avg_temp_f
FROM pier WHERE ts_doy >= 260 AND ts_doy <= 270 AND ts_season = 2
GROUP BY ts_doy ORDER BY ts_doy

SELECT DISTINCT fish_date_season, fish_date_doy FROM trips 
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy >= 200 
ORDER BY fish_date_doy LIMIT 20

SELECT cls, fish_date_doy, COUNT(*) as trip_count, AVG(yt::float / NULLIF(anglers, 0)) as avg_yt_per_angler
FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy >= 200
GROUP BY cls, fish_date_doy ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, cls
